speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a pediatric patient presenting with a 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain. To understand the severity of your condition, please tell me your age and current weight. Also, is the leg pain constant or does it worsen when you move your legs?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (likely Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia). The combination of fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe night pain in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of bone marrow infiltration. I will now order a Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential, Peripheral Smear, and request images of the affected leg bones.
